title: Paint by Number Guide
titleFull: Paint by Number Guide — How to Use PaintKit
metaDescription: Step-by-step guide to creating your paint by number pattern with PaintKit. Learn how to choose colors, canvas size, detail level, and export your design.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.content: Create your paint by number pattern in 4 simple steps:

steps.desc: Choose a photo from your device. High-resolution images produce the best results.
Configure color count, canvas size, detail level, and style.
PaintKit converts your photo into a numbered pattern — entirely in your browser.
Download your pattern as a high-resolution PNG or print-ready A4/A3 PDF.

colorCount.title: Color Count
colorCount.content: Controls diagram complexity. More colors = more realistic, but harder to paint.

options.label: 24 colors (Beginner)
options.effect: Large, simple regions — fast to paint, great for first-timers

options.label: 48 colors (Advanced)
options.effect: Fine region division, closest to the original photo

detailLevel.title: Detail Level
detailLevel.content: Controls how finely regions are split.

options.label: Low
options.effect: Large regions, fast painting, abstract feel

options.label: High
options.effect: Small regions included, detailed work, best for high-res photos

canvasSize.title: Canvas Size
canvasSize.content: Choose based on how you plan to print.

options.label: A5
options.effect: Portable, small print, great for practice

options.label: A4
options.effect: Standard home printer size, most versatile

options.label: Frame sizes (F4–F50)
options.effect: For printing directly onto canvas frames

colorGuide.title: Color Guide Mode
colorGuide.content: Lightly tints each region with its assigned paint color.

options.label: Outline Only
options.effect: Traditional diagram style, for experienced painters

options.label: With Color
options.effect: Each region shows its color faintly — recommended for beginners

options.label: Clean
options.effect: Simple, broad regions — good for quick painting

options.label: Detailed
options.effect: More regions and finer lines — good for realistic results

fitMode.title: Fit Mode
fitMode.content: How to handle aspect ratio differences between photo and canvas.

options.label: Fit
options.effect: Entire image fits within canvas, may leave empty margins

options.label: Fill
options.effect: Canvas fully covered, may crop edges. Adjust with crop preview.

tips.title: Tips for Best Results
items: Use high-resolution images (1000px+) for the best detail.
For portraits and pets, use 48 colors + High detail level.
For simple landscapes or illustrations, use 24 colors + Low detail level.
A4 is the most versatile print size — works with most home printers.
Use Color Guide mode if you are a beginner.

supplies.title: What You'll Need to Paint
supplies.intro: Once your pattern is ready, grab these three supplies and you're set to start painting.
supplies.affiliateNotice: These are Amazon Associates affiliate links. I may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you.

items.name: Acrylic Paint Set (24 Colors)
items.desc: Matches PaintKit's 24-color beginner setting. One tube per color number in your pattern.

items.name: Acrylic Brush Set
items.desc: Flat brush for large regions, liner brush for edges and numbers. A mixed set covers both.

items.name: Mixing Palette
items.desc: Use to mix and thin colors. A flat plastic palette with wells works best for acrylics.
